meta.purpose: Ergonomics tracker for motorized sit/stand desk — detects sitting/standing via VL53L1X ToF laser sensor, tracks sessions, nudges user to take breaks
meta.target-user: Single user (zentala) at a motorized sit/stand desk

hardware.sensor: Grove VL53L1X v2 — mounted under desk, pointing down to floor

feature.name: desk-state-detection
feature.description: Detects SITTING / STANDING / WALKING / AWAY based on sensor distance + keyboard/mouse activity
feature.debounce: 5 stable readings required before state change

feature.name: session-tracking
feature.description: Tracks sitting session duration, enforces configurable limit (default 40 min), break credit rules (proportional multiplier)

feature.name: points-system
feature.description: +1/min standing, +5/lap bonus, -0.5/min sitting; daily_score in tooltip + floating window

feature.name: standing-progress-bar
feature.description: Overlay bar fills 0-to-standing_target_mins, lap flash at 100%

feature.name: communication-architecture
feature.description: Profile-driven signal system: CommunicationPolicy decides signals (tray/overlay/notify), CommunicationProfile configures thresholds, visual patterns and escalation. Replaces AlertManager.
feature.profiles: JSON files for communication (default/aggressive/gentle/silent/demo) and ergonomic (standard/strict/relaxed/demo/default) profiles

feature.name: ui
feature.component: Height tooltip, colored dot icon (neutral/yellow/red), context menu
Widget-based: OneBar, TimelineZen, or Placeholder via registry
WinAPI popup at session limit, progressive escalation with snooze
First-launch onboarding, Tauri WebviewWindow, dismiss persisted

feature.name: widget-system
feature.description: WidgetProps interface + registry; active_widget in AppConfig; widgets are FC components

feature.name: persistence
feature.description: SQLite stores session history, today summaries

feature.name: settings
feature.description: Sit/stand limits, calibration, notification prefs, widget picker, profile selector — tauri-plugin-store

feature.name: auto-connect
feature.description: Auto-detects zntl-desk-sensor v1 on serial ports via PING/PONG handshake

feature.name: notifications
feature.description: Native desktop notifications with trigger_test_notification command, configurable backend

feature.name: google-fit-steps
feature.description: Opt-in walking-steps badge in OneBarWidget — fetches today's step count from Google Fit REST API. OAuth2 offline access with one-time consent (helper script: apps/desk/scripts/google-fit-auth.cjs). Configured via GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN in apps/desk/.env (gitignored). Optional GOOGLE_FIT_STEPS_SOURCE overrides auto-discovered data source. See ADR 012.
feature.error-model: Backend classifies failures as auth_revoked (invalid_grant / 401 → re-run OAuth helper) or transient (network / 5xx / parse → exponential backoff)

Health IPC: get_health_today, refresh_health_now — both return a symmetric HealthView merged across every registered source (E021-T02, replaces commands_google_fit.rs)
Source-agnostic DTOs: HealthSnapshot (steps + optional heart_rate_bpm/hrv_rmssd_ms + source_id + fetched_at_ms), HealthView, HealthErrorKind (alias of google_fit ErrorKind). ts-rs exported

HealthSource trait (id/view/refresh) + HealthAggregator: merges sources by freshest fetched_at_ms, passes errors through with AuthRevoked outranking Transient. The inlet the LAN push source (T03) registers into
Aggregator tests over the real trait — happy / nil / empty / error paths, freshness ordering, "a healthy source never hides another source's error"

Shared-secret guard for the remote server's write endpoints — require_token(headers, expected) with a hand-rolled constant-time compare; unset DESK_REMOTE_TOKEN answers 503 (closed), never 200 (E021-T03)
7 tests: match / wrong / missing header / unconfigured / non-ASCII header, and constant_time_eq agreeing with == including the 256-length-multiple case a naive u8 accumulator gets wrong

LAN push inlet POST /display/health — token required, 1 KiB body cap, schema {steps_today, heart_rate_bpm?, hrv_rmssd_ms?, source_id(1..64), measured_at_ms} into PushHealthSource, registered in HealthAggregator, snapshot withdrawn after 1h (E021-T03)

12 tests driving the real seam route → PushHealthSource → HealthAggregator via axum oneshot: authenticated push merges, shows in /display/api and in last_view(), 401/413/422/400/503 paths, staleness boundary

Low-level Fit layer — credentials, endpoints, error classification (AuthRevoked vs Transient), and SourceCache: per-data-type source discovery with a 1h failure TTL. Endpoints injectable for wiremock tests
Fit HTTP calls — OAuth refresh, list_step_sources / list_heart_rate_sources, fetch_steps, fetch_heart_rate (aggregate over com.google.heart_rate.bpm), rank_sources
Fit wire types (OAuthTokenResponse, AggregateResponse with total_steps / average_bpm) + ErrorKind

GoogleFitService: implements HealthSource, caches the HealthSnapshot, single-call dedup via tokio broadcast, best-effort heart rate that never fails the steps refresh, DST-correct local-day window with injected clock
10 wiremock-backed integration tests — steps and heart-rate happy paths, auth_revoked, 5xx, malformed JSON, no-heart-rate-data

Outbound ntfy/generic webhook push — fire-and-forget send, 5s per-attempt timeout, one retry on 5xx/timeout, JSON body {title, message, priority, tags}. URL from AppConfig or DESK_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL, gated by the notify_webhook_enabled toggle
9 wiremock-backed tests: happy body shape, nil/empty/disabled config, 5xx retry, retry ceiling, timeout retry, 4xx no-retry

Optional AI reply to a dictated voice note — BYOK OpenRouter chat completion, key from OPENROUTER_API_KEY, model from AppConfig.voice_ai_model else google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite, fixed ergonomics-coach system prompt (max 60 words, PL/EN), 8s timeout, endpoint overridable for tests. Not wired to a route yet
12 tests: from_env key/model resolution, wiremock happy path, request shape, blank transcript (no call), empty content, no choices, 401 rejected, 5xx, malformed 200, timeout
